labrador.name: Labrador
facts: Labs have webbed toes, making them excellent swimmers
They were originally bred to help fishermen haul nets in Newfoundland
A Lab's nose has 300 million scent receptors - humans have just 5 million
Labs are the most popular dog breed in the US for over 30 years running

poodle.name: Poodle
facts: Poodles are the second most intelligent dog breed after Border Collies
Their fancy haircuts were originally designed to protect joints while swimming
The name 'Poodle' comes from the German word 'pudeln' meaning 'to splash'
Elvis Presley loved Poodles and gave them as gifts to women he dated

bulldog.name: Bulldog
facts: Bulldogs can't swim - their heavy heads make them sink
They were originally bred for bull-baiting in 13th century England
Most Bulldogs are born via C-section due to their large heads
Winston Churchill was often compared to a Bulldog for his tenacity

beagle.name: Beagle
facts: Beagles have about 220 million scent receptors
Snoopy from Peanuts is the world's most famous Beagle
They were bred small enough to be carried in saddlebags during hunts
Beagles are used at airports to sniff out contraband food

husky.name: Husky
facts: Huskies can run up to 100 miles per day in sled teams
They have a special double coat that keeps them warm at -60°F
Huskies' eyes can be brown, blue, or one of each (heterochromia)
In 1925, Huskies ran 674 miles to deliver medicine to Nome, Alaska

corgi.name: Corgi
facts: Queen Elizabeth II owned more than 30 Corgis during her reign
Welsh legend says Corgis were gifts from woodland fairies
Their name means 'dwarf dog' in Welsh
Corgis were bred to herd cattle by nipping at their heels

dachshund.name: Dachshund
facts: Dachshund means 'badger dog' in German - they were bred to hunt them
Their long bodies let them dig into badger burrows
A Dachshund was the first Olympic mascot (Munich 1972)
Picasso had a Dachshund named Lump who appeared in his artwork

goldenRetriever.name: Golden Retriever
facts: Goldens have 'soft mouths' that can carry eggs without breaking them
They were bred in Scotland to retrieve waterfowl during hunts
A Golden named Augie holds the record for most tennis balls in mouth (6)
They're the 4th smartest dog breed

shibaInu.name: Shiba Inu
facts: Shiba Inu is the most popular companion dog in Japan
They're known for the 'Shiba scream' - a unique high-pitched vocalization
Shibas are one of the oldest dog breeds, dating back 3,000 years
The 'Doge' meme features a Shiba Inu named Kabosu

frenchBulldog.name: French Bulldog
facts: Frenchies can't swim due to their front-heavy bodies
They were bred in England but became popular in France
Their bat-like ears are a defining feature of the breed
French Bulldogs snore loudly due to their flat faces

germanShepherd.name: German Shepherd
facts: German Shepherds are the world's leading police and military dogs
Rin Tin Tin was a German Shepherd who starred in 27 Hollywood films
They can learn a new command after only 5 repetitions
A German Shepherd named Buddy was America's first guide dog (1928)

rottweiler.name: Rottweiler
facts: Rottweilers descended from Roman cattle-driving dogs
They were used to pull carts for butchers in Germany
Rottweilers have one of the strongest bite forces of any dog
Despite their tough image, they're known as 'gentle giants' with family
